model_annotations.Bulgarian: The plot titled "Hidden State Mean" displays the absolute mean of hidden states across different layers, with the x-axis labeled "Layer" ranging from 0 to 22 in linear increments of 5, and the y-axis labeled "Abs Mean" ranging from 0 to 4 in linear increments of 1. Three lines are plotted: a blue dashed line representing the "hidden state mean before gate" with an average of 0.71, which starts near 0.1 at layer 0, remains relatively flat until layer 18, then sharply increases to over 4 by layer 22; an orange dotted line for the "hidden state mean after gate" with an average of 0.05, which remains nearly flat and close to 0 across all layers; and a green solid line for the "hidden state mean of baseline" with an average of 0.04, which also remains nearly flat and close to 0 across all layers. The blue dashed line shows a significant rise after layer 18, while the other two lines remain consistently low throughout.
